title: Installable PWA shell: manifest, service worker and update prompt
goal: Installable PWA shell: manifest, service worker and update prompt
acceptance: Lighthouse-installable manifest and icons; offline shell; an update shows a prompt, never a silent reload
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1.5 hours agent; former 1-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history. Revised 2026-11-12 (PR #286): implemented with browser acceptance (test/pwa.browser.mjs) and file checks (test/pwa.test.mjs); about 0.25 h spent so far (stated: worktree created 06:09 UTC, PR opened 06:17 UTC; reading the records before that not counted separately). About 0.5 h remains: fresh-context design review, CI on #286, merge. Baseline 1.5 h unchanged.
